title: Somethin' Stupid
lyrics:
[00:10.99]I know I stand in line until you think
[00:14.01]You have the time to spend an evening with me
[00:20.30]And if we go someplace to dance
[00:22.80]I know that there's a chance you won't be leaving with me
[00:29.55]Then afterwards, we drop into a quiet little place
[00:33.78]And have a drink or two
[00:38.80]And then I go and spoil it all
[00:41.17]By saying somethin' stupid like, "I love you"
[00:47.70]I can see it in your eyes that you despise
[00:51.12]The same old lies you heard the night before
[00:57.30]And though it's just a line to you, for me, it's true
[01:00.89]And never seemed so right before
[01:06.56]I practice everyday to find some clever lines
[01:10.11]To say to make the meaning come true
[01:15.83]But then I think I'll wait until the evening gets late
[01:19.96]And I'm alone with you
[01:24.98]The time is right, your perfume fills my head
[01:27.97]The stars get red and, oh, the night's so blue
[01:34.19]And then I go and spoil it all
[01:36.53]By saying somethin' stupid like, "I love you"
[02:01.84]The time is right, your perfume fills my head
[02:04.86]The stars get red and, oh, the night's so blue
[02:11.05]And then I go and spoil it all
[02:13.50]By saying somethin' stupid like, "I love you"
[02:20.03]"I love you"
[02:24.66]"I love you"
[02:29.25]"I love you"
[02:33.77]"I love you"
